timeline.event: checkout service deployed config_v42 with EU tax endpoint mapping change
checkout service logs tax service request failed: region mismatch for eu-order
checkout service retry failed: tax endpoint us-east cannot serve eu tax quote
incident detected: EU checkout requests failing with tax calculation errors

root_cause: checkout config change misrouted EU tax requests to incorrect endpoint
why_it_happened: checkout service config_v42 deployment switched EU tax endpoint mapping
misconfigured endpoint mapping caused EU tax requests to be sent to us-east endpoint
us-east tax endpoint cannot serve EU tax quotes, resulting in region mismatch errors
ruled_out_hypotheses: payment gateway outage (would affect both EU and US traffic)
database pool exhaustion (presents as timeout saturation, not region mismatch)
immediate_mitigation: rollback checkout config to last known good version (config_v41)
